title: Πύργοι της Ελλάδας — Towers in Greece
description: Πύργοι (towers) across Greece — Byzantine, Frankish, Venetian, Ottoman, and modern. Includes the White Tower of Thessaloniki (Λευκός Πύργος), the Tower of the Winds (Αέρηδες), the Frankish Tower of the Acropolis, tower-houses (πυργόσπιτα) of Mani and the Balkans, Naxos pyrgoi (e.g. Πύργος Μπαζαίου, Πύργος Χειμάρρου), Achaia towers, and clock towers across mainland Greece. Sourced from el.wikipedia category Πύργοι στην Ελλάδα + 3 subcategories, enriched with Wikidata.
